description: This file contains functions for establishing and managing a MongoDB connection using Mongoose, including connection setup, retrieving the database instance, and obtaining collections. It also includes event handlers for connection status changes.

methods.name: connectDB
methods.description: Establishes a connection to MongoDB, sets up event handlers for connection status, and returns the mongoose connection object.

methods.name: getDb
methods.description: Ensures a connection is established and returns the current MongoDB database instance.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Retrieves a MongoDB collection by name or list of candidate names, returning the first existing collection or defaulting to the first candidate.
